newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea prepares 3-yr economic revival plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea prepares 3-yr economic revival plan - paper.

text.p: South Korea's Ministry of Finance and Economy is preparing a three-year plan to boost the nation's sluggish economy, a local newspaper said on Sunday.
The Chosun Ilbo newspaper said the 1997-1999 plan may be announced this month at the earliest.
"Finance and Economy Minister Kang Kyong-shik gave orders to the finance ministry to come up with a three-year plan," the paper quoted a senior government official as saying.
"So the plan is currently being prepared," he said.
The official said the plan would focus mainly on structural changes to the country's fragile economy.
